# Gnomcode — The Runtime for AI Coding Agents

> Gnomcode is a local-first runtime, model orchestrator, and encrypted remote control for AI coding agents. It is free and open source (Apache-2.0) with release builds for Windows x64, macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel) and Linux (x86_64, arm64, .deb), plus an npm package (`npm i -g gnomcode`).

## Core Capabilities
- **Model Switching**: Switch mid-conversation between Claude Code, OpenAI Codex and Antigravity. Compiles objectives, changed files, and recent turns into a local handoff.
- **Mobile Remote Companion**: Link your phone to your desktop to read conversations, send follow-up instructions and approve Claude Code permission prompts (Codex and Antigravity in opt-in protocol mode) over an end-to-end encrypted channel. Remote is a prototype.
- **Usage and limits**: Unified tracking of tokens, estimated API-equivalent spend, and quota pools across the three supported agents with declared trust levels (exact, estimated, api, unknown).
- **Fail-Open & Local-First**: The daemon runs on loopback (127.0.0.1). Redacted history remains local on your machine. Zero telemetry or phone-home.

## Supported Agents
- Anthropic Claude Code (`claude`)
- OpenAI Codex (`codex`)
- Google Antigravity (`agy`)

Gnomcode 1.0 supports exactly these three agents.

- [Claude Code vs Codex](https://gnomcode.vercel.app/docs/claude-code-vs-codex): Differences, limits and using both.
- [Quota limits explained](https://gnomcode.vercel.app/docs/quota-limits-explained): How agent usage windows and resets work.
- [Changelog](https://gnomcode.vercel.app/changelog): Release notes for every version.
- [FAQ](https://gnomcode.vercel.app/docs/faq): Frequently asked questions on security, subscriptions, and integrations.

## Progressive Web App & Remote
- Web Application: https://gnomcode.vercel.app/remote
- Mobile PWA: Installable directly from browser on iOS and Android with background notifications for agent completion and approval requests.

## Downloads

- [Downloads](https://gnomcode.vercel.app/downloads): Current release installers and archives for Windows x64 (Setup.exe and ZIP), Windows ARM64 CLI, macOS Apple Silicon and Intel, and Linux x86_64/arm64 (tar.gz, .deb). Every release publishes versioned SHA-256 checksums. Windows installers are not Authenticode-signed and macOS apps are not notarized; Windows automatic updates verify an Ed25519 signature.
- npm: `npm install -g gnomcode` installs the CLI for Windows, macOS and Linux (including musl).

## Files and project trust

The console browses workspace files, Git changes and referenced agent documents for Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity. File previews can expand and complete files can download. Desktop project trust remembers tool/folder approval for the exact workspace; permission and sandbox changes still ask. Remote attachment uploads support files up to 15 MiB and messages wait for saved-file confirmation. Old desktop listings can be removed from Devices without deleting local sessions.

Remote Agent terminal exposes the hosted agent screen and explicit text/keys over E2EE, with clickable login links and manual code entry. Arbitrary workspace shells remain local. Desktop localhost OAuth callbacks are not proxied. Limit rejections appear directly in the conversation; low-limit notifications are deduplicated until recovery or a confirmed new window, including across daemon restart.
